title: BodyPlan - contour + levels + openings of one floor band (shared body core #1736)
description: Input of tools/methods/body/body_lattice.py (the core reads nothing else). One band = one typical-floor module replicated `floors` times by `step` from `z0`. Revit route: jobs/garibaldi22/body-training-1619/hooks/floor_from_dump.py; DWG route: tools/methods/body/plan_adapter_dwg.py. Extra provenance keys are allowed. body_lattice.validate_plan adds the checks JSON Schema cannot express (CCW rings, loops rising inside the step, zone/window bounds, known materials).

step.description: floor-to-floor height of the module, m

z0.description: world z of the module base (loop 0), m

loops.description: module-relative z of the horizontal lines, first 0, strictly rising, < step (BM-02)

cuts.description: perimeter positions s of full-height stations (jambs, zone joints), m

zones.description: [s0, s1, material] finish zones along the perimeter (BM-11)

windows.description: [ring, s0, s1, wl, wh, r]: opening between stations s0..s1 and loop indices wl..wh; r > 0 = reveal depth (cell removed, reveal tube), r = 0 = cell kept with WINDOW material

insets.description: separate closed boxes [cx, cy, z0, w, d, h, rot] (BM-04, D336)

max_side_m.description: BM-11 split of long sides (0 = off)

zone_overlap.description: overlapping zones: error (default) or the first listed wins
